name: STORM_SQL ep182026
sql: SELECT storm_id, basin, number, season, status, names, aliases, first_seen, last_seen, last_lat, last_lon, updated_ts FROM tropical_storms WHERE storm_id = 'ep182026'

name: ENTRY_NEWEST_SQL ep202026
sql: SELECT vintage_key, issued_ts, fetch_ts, meta FROM tropical_file_vintage_in_force WHERE source = 'nhc' AND product = 'storm_entry' AND storm_id = 'ep202026' ORDER BY issued_ts DESC, fetch_ts DESC, vintage_id DESC LIMIT 1

name: ADVISORY_AT_SQL ep182026 054
sql: SELECT advisory, init_ts, min(valid_ts) AS position_valid_ts FROM tropical_track_points_in_force WHERE storm_id = 'ep182026' AND source = 'nhc_official' AND advisory = '054' GROUP BY advisory, init_ts ORDER BY init_ts DESC LIMIT 1

name: ENTRY_SQL ep182026 054
sql: SELECT vintage_key, issued_ts, fetch_ts, meta FROM tropical_file_vintage_in_force WHERE source = 'nhc' AND product = 'storm_entry' AND storm_id = 'ep182026' AND vintage_key LIKE '054:%' ORDER BY fetch_ts DESC, vintage_id DESC LIMIT 1

name: FILES_SQL products ep182026 054
sql: SELECT v.source, v.product, v.vintage_key, v.r2_key, v.sha256, v.byte_size, v.issued_ts, v.fetch_ts, v.meta, v.revision, v.corrected FROM tropical_file_vintage_in_force AS v WHERE v.source = 'nhc' AND v.product = ANY ('{cone_kmz,ww_kmz,surge_ww_kml}'::text[]) AND v.storm_id = 'ep182026' AND v.vintage_key = '054' ORDER BY v.product

name: DISPLAY_FILES_SQL products ep182026 054
sql: SELECT 'display' AS source, v.product, v.advisory_or_cycle, v.vintage_key, v.revision, v.revision > 0 AS corrected, v.r2_key, v.sha256, v.byte_size, v.issued_ts, v.published_ts, v.meta, o.r2_key AS original_r2_key, o.sha256 AS original_sha256, o.byte_size AS original_bytes FROM tropical_display_in_force AS v LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT a.r2_key, a.sha256, a.byte_size FROM tropical_file_vintage AS a WHERE v.revision > 0 AND a.source = 'display' AND a.product = v.product AND a.storm_id = v.storm_id AND a.vintage_key = v.advisory_or_cycle AND a.status = 'banked') AS o ON true WHERE v.product = ANY ('{display:cone,display:ww,display:surge_ww}'::text[]) AND v.storm_id = 'ep182026' AND v.advisory_or_cycle = '054' ORDER BY v.product
